title: ESLint is configured with type-aware rules, including the BigInt/Number mixing guard (restrict-plus-operands, the C01 lint layer), but nothing runs it: no lint script, no CI step, and the type-aware parser cannot see scripts/ or test/ because no tsconfig includes them

evidence.note: recommendedTypeChecked with projectService; restrict-plus-operands with allowNumberAndString false ("D-07: Flag BigInt/Number mixing at lint time"); no-unsafe-argument warn
ignores dist, artifacts, cache, typechain-types, node_modules only
the test job has no lint step

sibling_sites_checked: eslint.config.mjs is the only ESLint config at the base (no .eslintrc*). The lint error count is measured by plan 22-16 (counted, not gated, per the SPEC); the projectService limitation for files outside every tsconfig follows from AUD-ROOT-003 and is not exercised here (ESLint was not run in this plan).
severity_rationale: S4: a guard that exists only on paper; the C01 defects it would flag are audited by the src slices directly.
recommendation: Phase 26/28 (OD-23 strictness target, lint-zero) and Phase 31 (blocking gate): add a lint script, cover scripts/ and test/ through a tsconfig, and run it in CI.
